# Restoration models

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py from the model cards; do not edit. -->

32 restoration models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one RGB image. Output: the restored (upscaled) image, `model.scale` x the input size, RGB in [0, 1]. `tile=` runs large images in overlapping tiles (as ComfyUI).

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; `fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW` measures yours. The summary uses one input, 512x512: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under `torch.compile` and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable ([export](../export.md); memory: the engine's device memory + torch's peak). – = not measured; no kernels = the family has no kernels backend (reason under its table).

Other devices: [Apple M1 Pro 16 GB](../devices/apple-m1-pro-16gb.md), [NVIDIA L4](../devices/l4-22gb.md), [NVIDIA L40S](../devices/l40s-44gb.md), [NVIDIA A10](../devices/a10-22gb.md), [NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB](../devices/a100-sxm4-40gb.md), [NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000](../devices/rtx-pro-6000-96gb.md); [across devices](../benchmarks.md#other-devices).

## LaMa (big-lama inpainting)

LaMa big-lama (Suvorov et al., Samsung AI, WACV 2022): fills the masked hole of an image (object removal) with a fast-Fourier-convolution network trained on scene photos. Apache-2.0 code and weights; the Places365 training images are for research use only (see the card).

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `big-lama` | synthetic (512x512) | original<br>portable<br>kernels | 38.0<br>26.0<br>21.2 | 239 / 286<br>219 / 242<br>219 / 284 |

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Original code: <https://github.com/advimman/lama> at `786f5936b27f`
- Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: Apache-2.0
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/advimman/lama/blob/786f5936b27fb3dacd2b1ad799e4de968ea697e7/LICENSE ; https://github.com/advimman/lama/blob/786f5936b27fb3dacd2b1ad799e4de968ea697e7/README.md ; https://huggingface.co/smartywu/big-lama/blob/05cb2be7f8dbe6ca7c6e78f4fc827a4b2baaa4a9/README.md
- Training data: Places365-Challenge (8 M scene images, 365 categories) (big-lama: Places365-Challenge (about 4.5 M images used) with LaMa's random wide / box masks, 256 x 256 crops (paper Sec. 4 and README).)
- Options: `cuda_graphs` = True (speed only)
- Kernel libraries: `cudnn_hacc`
- Variants: `big-lama`
- Outputs: image
- Input size: any H x W >= 16, padded to a multiple of 8
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `big-lama` 3000x4000 (5.1 GiB peak allocated, 6.8 reserved)
- `big-lama` original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; advimman/lama@786f5936b27f FFCResNetGenerator, predict.py padding / masking / paste-back
- `big-lama` load / first call: original 0.52 s / 0.327 s, portable 0.31 s / 0.267 s, kernels 0.65 s / 0.122 s
- Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.002 and p99 <= 0.01 (absolute error of the output `image`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `big-lama` | 0.00022 / 0.00403 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |

### Limitations

- Fills the masked region from the surrounding image; it does not take a text prompt. The authors' refinement step (`refine=True`, an iterative multi-scale optimisation) is not implemented.
- Any nonzero mask pixel is a hole (upstream binarises with `mask > 0`): anti-aliased or JPEG masks grow; threshold them first.

</details>

## CodeFormer

CodeFormer (Zhou et al., S-Lab NTU, NeurIPS 2022): restores a degraded face (an aligned 512 x 512 crop) by predicting codes of a learned face codebook; fidelity w trades quality against faithfulness. Non-commercial code and weights (S-Lab License 1.0).

Commercial use: **no** (code: LicenseRef-noncommercial (noncommercial); weights: LicenseRef-noncommercial).

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `codeformer` | synthetic (512x512) | original<br>portable<br>kernels<br>portable + torch.compile<br>TensorRT fp16 | 85.7<br>48.6<br>no kernels<br>30.8<br>16.3 | 959 / 1090<br>512 / 638<br>no kernels<br>407 / 458<br>593 / 642 |

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Original code: <https://github.com/sczhou/CodeFormer> at `b33cc7d639d6`
- Code licence: LicenseRef-noncommercial (noncommercial); files: `LICENSE`
- Weights licence: LicenseRef-noncommercial
- Licence evidence: https://github.com/sczhou/CodeFormer/blob/b33cc7d639d6545bfcccc7e0bc6ae51f24e79c2b/LICENSE ; https://github.com/sczhou/CodeFormer/blob/b33cc7d639d6545bfcccc7e0bc6ae51f24e79c2b/README.md (weights: https://github.com/sczhou/CodeFormer/releases/tag/v0.1.0)
- Training data: Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ, 70k face images) (Paper Sec. 4.1: FFHQ (70 000 faces, resized to 512 x 512) with synthetic degradations (blur, downsampling, noise, JPEG).)
- Options: `fidelity` = 0.5 (0.0 to 1.0; also `fidelity_weight`)

- no kernels: not built yet: a VQGAN of 3x3 convolutions with GroupNorm around a 16 x 16 transformer; fp16-accumulate convolutions (`cudnn_hacc`) are the next step.
- `codeformer` 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 34 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 65 s (ONNX + engine).
- `codeformer` original 512x512: upstream inference_codeformer.py on the aligned face, float32, w 0.5

## DAT

DAT (Chen et al., ICCV 2023): a x4 upscaler for clean (bicubic) images that alternates spatial and channel attention, in three sizes (DAT, DAT-2, DAT-light). Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

| variant | input | backend | time (ms) | peak memory (MiB, allocated / reserved) |

## DRCT

DRCT (Hsu et al., CVPRW 2024): a x4 upscaler for clean (bicubic) images, Swin Transformer blocks with dense connections inside each group, in two sizes (DRCT, DRCT-L). MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Commercial use: yes.

## HAT

HAT (Chen et al., CVPR 2023): a x4 upscaler mixing window attention, channel attention and overlapping cross-attention: two models for clean (bicubic) images (large and small) and a GAN model for real-world photos. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

|---|---|---|---|---|

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.02 vs the original. GPU, bfloat16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.01 and p99 <= 0.05 (absolute error of the output `image`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seedvr2-3b` | 0.0 / 0.0 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `nf4@e236d80ba78b:sm_120` |
| `seedvr2-7b` | 0.0 / 0.0 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `nf4@e236d80ba78b:sm_120` |

### Limitations

- Generative restoration: the output depends on `seed` (one CPU generator draws the VAE posterior noise and the diffusion noise, upstream's default 666); other seeds give other plausible details.
- One frame per call: the clip mode of the original (temporal attention over 4n + 1 frames) is not used by this image API.
- The input is padded on the bottom and right (replicate) so that `scale x` its size is a multiple of 16, and the output cropped back; the original centre-crops the resized frame to a multiple of 16 instead.
- No colour fix: the authors' scripts optionally match the output colours to the input with StableSR's wavelet reconstruction (non-commercial code), which is not included.
- The 3 B model needs ~7 GB for its weights plus the VAE's activations (~14 GB peak at 960 x 1696 output); `stream=False` keeps them resident; by default (`stream=True`, CUDA) they stay in ~6.6 GB of page-locked host RAM (~9 GB peak at that size).
- The 7 B model's weights are 16.5 GB in bf16: it runs with the default `stream=True` (blocks in ~16.5 GB of page-locked host RAM; load fails with an error when less is free) or `quant="nf4"` (~4.6 GB resident); with `stream=false` and no quant it runs out of GPU memory.
- `quant="nf4"` changes the generated detail: 23-27 dB PSNR against the bf16 output (3 B, 4 clips; 7 B: 26-31 dB, 2 clips), about as far as another `seed` (18-24 dB), with ~3.5x smaller transformer blocks.

</details>

  - `swinir-l-x4-real`: DIV2K (NTIRE 2017 super-resolution, 1000 2K images), Flickr2K (2650 2K Flickr images, EDSR), OutdoorSceneTraining (OST, SFTGAN), Waterloo Exploration Database (4744 natural images), Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ, 70k face images), Manga109 (109 Japanese manga volumes), SCUT-CTW1500 (curved scene text) (README, Training and testing: real-world SR, SwinIR-L on DIV2K + Flickr2K + OST + WED + FFHQ (first 2000) + Manga109 + SCUT-CTW1500 (first 100) with BSRGAN degradations.)
- Kernel libraries: `cudnn_hacc`
- Variants: `swinir-m-x4`, `swinir-m-x2`, `swinir-m-x4-real`, `swinir-l-x4-real`
- Outputs: image
- Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
- Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): `swinir-m-x4` 1024x1024 (11.0 GiB peak allocated, 14.4 reserved); `swinir-m-x2` 1024x1024 (11.0 GiB peak allocated, 12.3 reserved); `swinir-m-x4-real` 512x512 (3.1 GiB peak allocated, 5.6 reserved); `swinir-l-x4-real` 512x512 (4.0 GiB peak allocated, 5.8 reserved)
- `swinir-m-x4` 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 62 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 104 s (ONNX + engine).
- `swinir-m-x2` 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 60 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 102 s (ONNX + engine).
- `swinir-m-x4-real` 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 60 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 109 s (ONNX + engine).
- `swinir-l-x4-real` 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 68 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 193 s (ONNX + engine).
- `swinir-m-x4` original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; upstream main_test_swinir.py, float32, no tile
- `swinir-m-x2` original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; upstream main_test_swinir.py, float32, no tile
- `swinir-m-x4-real` original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; upstream main_test_swinir.py, float32, no tile
- `swinir-l-x4-real` original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; upstream main_test_swinir.py, float32, no tile
- `swinir-m-x4` load / first call: original 2.07 s / 3.272 s, portable 0.44 s / 1.36 s, kernels 1.28 s / 0.646 s
- `swinir-m-x2` load / first call: original 2.95 s / 4.489 s, portable 0.38 s / 1.342 s, kernels 1.26 s / 0.631 s
- `swinir-m-x4-real` load / first call: original 2.06 s / 3.326 s, portable 0.4 s / 1.386 s, kernels 1.31 s / 0.697 s
- `swinir-l-x4-real` load / first call: original 2.15 s / 5.945 s, portable 0.7 s / 2.188 s, kernels 1.46 s / 1.103 s
- Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

### Measured

DIV2K validation HR images and the official bicubic LR images (x4 or x2, the model's scale), one pass without tiles; PSNR and SSIM (Gaussian 11 x 11, sigma 1.5) on the Y channel (BT.601) of the output rounded to uint8, `scale` px border cropped, averaged over the images. Real-ESRGAN is trained for real-world degradations, not bicubic, so its PSNR is low: the numbers compare our modes with the original, not with PSNR-oriented upscalers. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

| variant | dataset | original fp32 | portable | kernels | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `swinir-m-x4` | DIV2K validation (every 2nd: 50 images), bicubic x4 LR -> HR, PSNR / SSIM (Y) | 30.90 / 0.8423 | 30.90 / 0.8423 | 30.89 / 0.8422 |  |
| `swinir-m-x4-real` | DIV2K validation (every 2nd: 50 images), bicubic x4 LR -> HR, PSNR / SSIM (Y) | 26.71 / 0.7516 | 26.71 / 0.7516 | 26.71 / 0.7515 |  |
| `swinir-l-x4-real` | DIV2K validation (every 2nd: 50 images), bicubic x4 LR -> HR, PSNR / SSIM (Y) | 27.04 / 0.7628 | 27.04 / 0.7628 | 27.05 / 0.7628 |  |

Measured on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130, fastforks 45a5c91f, 2026-11-13.

### Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1.4e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `image`).

| variant | kernels error vs original, mean / p99 | GPU, torch | kernels used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `swinir-m-x4` | 0.00052 / 0.00192 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
| `swinir-m-x2` | 0.00039 / 0.00139 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
| `swinir-m-x4-real` | 0.00126 / 0.00498 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
| `swinir-l-x4-real` | 0.00082 / 0.0039 | RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130 | `cudnn_hacc@cudnn92400` |
